title: HURT MACHINES SHOW SMOKE AND SPARKS, NOT A HEALTH BAR
why: His 10-25 answer g-83: smoke and sparks only. The name plate still drew a 3 px health pip under every hurt machine. Machines now keep the name plate, smoke and sparks only; pillager bots, the hire, strays and the peddler keep their pip, and the Overseer keeps its boss bar.
now: A hurt machine shows smoke and sparks and no health bar under its name.
